firstPlayerRule: In multiplayer, whoever most recently made a mixed drink is the starting player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Give that player the Starting Player token. Players choose and reveal Action cards simultaneously, then resolve their actions in clockwise turn order.
Initial Leader placement proceeds counterclockwise from the last player. In the Full Game, the starting Spell choices and Ritual-marker placement use that same reverse order.
At the end of Autumn, Winter and Spring, pass the Starting Player token clockwise.
In solo play, you take the Starting Player token at setup.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://mindclashgames.com/our-games/septima/. A complete 113,488,684-byte retrieval succeeded under a 120 MB limit; its hash was recorded. All six listed pages were visually inspected. The mixed-drink instruction is part of both Basic and Full setup, outside the Full Game-only box. No alcoholic-content condition or definition of mixed drink was invented. Ordered action resolution distinguishes this from an entirely simultaneous game.
